Announcements
Register an Alternative Authentication
Method
Oct 28, 2026
Support for logging in to LINE via a Facebook account
ended in January 2024, and the ability to use that login
method will cease entirely by December 31, 2026.
To ensure you can continue using your LINE account,
please link your Apple or Google account by December 31,
2026.
If you do not register another authentication method by the
deadline, your Facebook-linked ID will be deleted, and you
will no longer be able to use your LINE account or items
associated with that account.
To continue using the information and items associated with
your account, please ensure you complete linking your
Apple or Google account by December 31, 2026.
You can register an alternative authentication method by
going to Settings > Account > Apple or Google.
If you have any questions regarding the registration process
or your account, please contact the Help Center.
Thank you for your continued support of LINE.
